name: Counterpart
description: Howard Silk is a lowly cog in a bureaucratic UN agency who is turning the last corner of a life filled with regret when he discovers the agency he works for is guarding a secret: a crossing to a parallel dimension.

videos.title: The Crossing
videos.overview: Howard Silk discovers the truth about where he works. The Office of Interchange searches for an assassin.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Howard must work together with his counterpart. Baldwin comes face to face with her past. Emily, from the other side, tries to make sense of her orders.

videos.title: The Lost Art of Diplomacy
videos.overview: Both sides turn to diplomacy to resolve a conflict. Emily obtains a special visa. Howard interrogates a suspect.

videos.title: Both Sides Now
videos.overview: Both Howards deepen their investigation of the conspiracy. Quayle meets one of Howard's sources. Clare must decide what to do about Baldwin.

videos.title: Shaking the Tree
videos.overview: Howard discovers another side of Emily. Howard and Emily search for answers about a mysterious drop site. Aldrich and Quayle seek intel from an old friend.

videos.title: Act Like You've Been Here Before
videos.overview: Aldrich questions a not-too recent death in the office. Emily, Howard and Shaw follow a lead. Nadia attends her other's funeral and closes a deal with Clare.

videos.title: The Sincerest Form of Flattery
videos.overview: Clare's past is revealed. Quayle suffers through his own birthday party and drinks too much.

videos.title: Love the Lie
videos.overview: The aftermath of the Indigo school discovery takes an emotional toll. Quayle grapples with his wife's new identity.

videos.title: No Man's Land (1)
videos.overview: Howard attempts to thwart the Guest's plans. Howard and Emily chase Kaspar.

videos.title: No Man's Land (2)
videos.overview: A crisis at the O.I. leaves both Howards stranded.

videos.title: Inside Out
videos.overview: While hiding in Howard’s life, Howard Prime must avoid detection at home and at the OI. Quayle and Clare struggle to adjust to their new arrangement.

videos.title: Outside In
videos.overview: Imprisoned on the Other Side, Howard's loyalties are tested. Emily Prime gets a promotion.

videos.title: Something Borrowed
videos.overview: Howard is transferred to a mysterious prison called Echo. An unexpected visit gives Emily a connection to her old life. Emily Prime and Shaw's investigation is met with resistance.

videos.title: Point of Departure
videos.overview: Howard Prime, Quayle and Clare must unite against a common enemy. Emily Prime turns her investigation towards her other. Yanek probes Howard's past.

videos.title: Shadow Puppets
videos.overview: A new revelation puts Howard Prime and Quayle in jeopardy. Life at Echo is disrupted. Clare reconnects with her past.

videos.title: Twin Cities
videos.overview: The origins of the Crossing are revealed.

videos.title: No Strings Attached
videos.overview: The fallout of the lockdown casts suspicions around the OI. Howard and Emily Prime find clues about the history of Management. Clare questions her allegiances.

videos.title: In from the Cold
videos.overview: Howard Prime and Emily work together to figure out Indigo's plans. Clare and Quayle consider their future. Howard must face the truth about his wife.

videos.title: You to You
videos.overview: Management makes a historic decision. Emily sends a warning. Quayle, Clare and Temple investigate the final Indigo cell. Howard Prime reaches out to an old contact.

videos.title: Better Angels
videos.overview: Mira's looming threat forges some unlikely alliances.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 12 nominations total
